SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 73 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/KA/2022/808 Dated 14-07-2022
GSTIN: 29MMMNN9012M1Z7 M/s Southern Infra Projects
FY: 2021-22

1. Issue 1: Non-payment of reverse charge GST under Section 9(3) amounting to Rs. 75,00,0/- on freight charges paid to Goods Transport Agencies (GTA) where GTA did not pay tax under forward charge.
2. Issue 2: Taxable turnover of outward supplies reported in GSTR-1 exceeds tax paid in GSTR-3B by Rs. 1,20,000/- due to unadjusted credit notes.
